masterplan.goal: FastAPI backend serving fine-tuned Qwen2.5-0.5B support model. Landing page frontend showing model capability (metrics + figures). Floating chat icon (bottom-right) opens chatbox wired to model via API.

model.note: merged weights, load direct, no peft needed at inference

figures.note: 11 PNGs: loss curve, accuracy, confusion matrix, base-vs-finetuned etc

stack.frontend: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, served as static files by FastAPI
stack.reason: single small model, single page -> no framework/bundler needed (ladder rung 4)

dir.file: main.py — FastAPI app, mounts static, defines routes
model.py — load merged model once at startup, generate() fn
index.html — landing page + chat widget markup
app.js — fetch metrics/figures, chat widget logic

phase.name: backend-core
phase.task: app/model.py: load tokenizer+model from results/qwen05b-support-merged at import time, apply chat_template, generate() with generation_config defaults (temp 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, rep_penalty 1.1)
app/main.py: GET /api/figures -> list figure filenames; mount /figures as StaticFiles(results/figures)

phase.name: landing-page
phase.task: index.html hero section: model name, one-line description
metrics section: cards for intent_accuracy, rouge/bleu, perplexity — base vs fine-tuned, pulled via fetch('/api/metrics')
figures gallery: grid of images from /figures, lazy load
style.css: clean minimal layout, responsive grid

phase.name: chat-widget
phase.task: fixed circular message icon, bottom-right, z-index top
click toggles chatbox panel (message list + input + send)
app.js: POST to /api/chat, append user+model bubbles, basic loading state

phase.name: verify
phase.task: open in browser, test chat + gallery render
self-check: minimal script or curl-based smoke test for /api/chat

out_of_scope.item: auth, multi-user sessions, chat history persistence
streaming tokens (plain request/response first; add SSE later if asked)
